meta.title: 你内耗的原因就是太拿对方当人了
meta.title_en: Your Drain Comes from Caring Too Much
meta.topic: 高情商表达 · 镜像反驳

scenes.context: 被说「天天点外卖是因为穷吗」，回敬「你没有家吗」——把攻击原样反弹。
sentences: 这又没贴禁止吸烟，你管我呢。
There's no no-smoking sign — mind your own business.
mind your own business（你管我呢）
你天天点外卖是因为家里穷吗？
Do you order takeout every day because you're poor?
takeout（外卖）
那你天天点外卖是因为你没有家吗？
Then do you order takeout because you don't have a home?
mirror（镜像反弹）
paraphrase: Toss the same logic right back at them.
Focus on your own business, not mine.
scenes.speak: There's no no-smoking sign — mind your own business. Do you order takeout every day because you're poor? Then do you order takeout because you don't have a home?

scenes.context: 用「没贴禁止打小鞭就可以尿你碗里」把对方逻辑推到荒谬。
sentences: 那这还没贴禁止打小鞭呢。
There's no sign against little firecrackers either.
firecrackers（小鞭）
我是不是可以尿你碗里啊。
Does that mean I can pee in your bowl?
absurd（荒谬）
你坐着饭回家狗都不吃。
Your cooking is so bad even the dog won't eat it.
even the dog won't（狗都不）
paraphrase: Push their rule to an absurd extreme to show its flaw.
Compare it to something ridiculous and the logic collapses.
scenes.speak: There's no sign against little firecrackers either. Does that mean I can pee in your bowl? Your cooking is so bad even the dog won't eat it.

scenes.context: 「臭东西看什么都是丑的」「你玩笑还没你长得好笑」金句一次释放。
sentences: 臭东西看什么都是丑的。
Garbage sees everything as ugly.
golden line（金句）
你玩笑还没你长得好笑呢。
Your joke isn't as funny as your face.
not as funny as（还没好笑）
管好你自己吧。
Just mind your own business.
mind（管好）
paraphrase: One sharp line ends the whole exchange.
Your jokes are less funny than you are — and that's saying a lot.
scenes.speak: Garbage sees everything as ugly. Your joke isn't as funny as your face. Just mind your own business.

practice: 被阴阳怪气时第一反应？
Don't explain yourself — mirror the attack.
Swap the keyword and toss the same logic back.
Push their rule to an absurd extreme to show its flaw.
One strong line ends the exchange on your terms.
pitfalls: 回怼是术，不当回事是道。
